{{incomplete|needs=Disc divisions, contents of the box, whether it includes closed captioning}} [[File:XY - Limited Edition Collection.png|thumb|XY - Limited Edition Collection]] [[File:XY - Limited Edition Collection angled.png|thumb|Angled cover image]] The '''Pokémon the Series: XY - Limited Edition Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set that was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on August 30, 2017. This DVD set is also referred to as the '''Pokémon the Series: XY Collector's Set''' in promotional material. Overall, the set includes 18 discs with 141 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7749. It contains all of the dubbed episodes from ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. Specifically, it has episodes from ''[[S17|Pokémon the Series: XY]]'', ''[[S18|Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest]]'', and ''[[S19|Pokémon the Series: XYZ]]''. ==Contents== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Kalos}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kalos}}" !
